_citation: Zhou X, Du J, Liang Y, Dai C, Zhao L, Liu X, Tan C, Mo L, Chen L. The Efficacy and Safety of Pharmacological Treatments for Restless Legs Syndrome: Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis. Front Neurosci. 2021;15:751643.
_design: Frequentist NMA (Stata network command, random-effects, REML), mean difference on IRLS 0-40 vs placebo. 46 RCTs, 10,674 patients, 10 drugs + placebo (11 nodes, 13 direct comparisons); studies 2004-2018; pharmacological treatments only.
_notes: MD (95% CI) are Zhou's primary-RLS analysis (Figure 7) where available; gabapentin and oxycodone-naloxone are from the all-studies analysis (Figure 3A / text) because Zhou lacked sufficient primary-RLS data for them. SUCRA values are from Figure 4 (all drugs, all studies). 'significant' is Zhou's stated conclusion vs placebo (every drug beat placebo except levodopa). Placebo SUCRA = 0.4%.

gabapentin.note: high SUCRA rests on limited/indirect data (Zhou cautions it is unstable)

oxycodone-naloxone.note: single trial (Trenkwalder 2013); second-line for severe/refractory RLS

iron.note: effective for ferritin <45 ug/L (MD -5.15); NOT significant for normal ferritin (MD -2.22, CI crosses 0)

levodopa.note: the ONLY drug Zhou found not significantly better than placebo (attributed to augmentation)
